description: Halt! Who goes there? Reveal yourself or face our wrath!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_1 at line 459

description: I mean no harm, Shaman.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_2 at line 570

description: This is your first and last warning. Ignore it, and my arrows will show no mercy.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_3 at line 681

description: Is this how the once-proud elder of the Elvish Whitewood Archer treats her guest, with threats of death without justification?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_4 at line 792

description: This is neither the time for theatrics or manners. Explain your purpose, stranger. And choose your words wisely…
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_5 at line 859

description: Straight to the point and without hesitation. That is to be expected from a Paladin of such status. Very well, listen to my request.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_6 at line 870

description: As you have decided, my name is of no importance, but my purpose rings true with righteousness. I am here to enlist your help, brave souls.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_7 at line 881

description: And why should we help you, stranger?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_8 at line 892

description: You may convince yourself that survival is your only option, but my goal answers your true desire: to rid the land of Morgana’s foul monsters.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_9 at line 903

description: Ha! You think a mere weakling like yourself could stand up against the savageness that is Morgana’s horde?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_10 at line 460

description: No, that is why I need your help. I may possess the insight to topple the dark forces, but without the strength to do so, my knowledge is useless.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_11 at line 471

description: I find it hard to trust such abilities from a stranger.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_12 at line 482

description: True. So to honor your service, I shall first and foremost help you take back Castle Camelot.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_13 at line 493

description: What nonsense are you sprouting? Castle Camelot has fallen?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_14 at line 504

description: Not quite. But if we do not return to the castle soon, I am afraid that Castle Camelot will finally meet its end.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_15 at line 515

description: If what you say is true, then we cannot afford to be stationed here any longer. We must hurry back to defend the castle!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_16 at line 526

description: You are making us play a very dangerous gamble here, stranger. Our armies were ordered to stay here by Duke Cador to defend the outskirts of the kingdom.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_17 at line 537

description: … But I cannot risk the possibility of Castle Camelot falling. I, Sir Geoffrey, will heed your warning and follow you back to the castle.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_18 at line 548

description: I, Zubair, shall also be of service.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_19 at line 559

description: If my friends agree to help you, then I, Adala, shall assist as well. But I have my eyes on you little girl. Do not think for a moment that I trust you.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_20 at line 571

description: Then it is settled. We shall venture forth towards Castle Camelot and protect the kingdom under your guidance. Do not disappoint us.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_21 at line 582

description: It seems we have made it in time.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_22 at line 593

description: Wait! Do you feel that?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_23 at line 604

description: Indeed, there is a suffocating aura of malice that is flooding the castle walls.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_24 at line 615

description: This sensation… it is similar to that of Morgana!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_25 at line 626

description: Ha, ha, ha, ha… so some of Camelot’s whelps have returned to roam their lost home.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_26 at line 637

description: Are you the one responsible for attacking the castle?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_27 at line 648

description: Of course! Only I, Forgon, the Blade of Morgan, could create such carnage! Sadly, that Duke Cador was quite the let-down. That acting king really was no King Arthur.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_28 at line 659

description: What did you do to the Duke?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_29 at line 670

description: I don’t remember; I think his head should be lying somewhere in the throne room.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_30 at line 682

description: You degenerate monster! I will end you!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_31 at line 693

description: My, my, what fighting words. Seeing as how I am still in a good mood, I shall let you strays leave the premise quietly. I will not hurt you. Not too much anyway.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_32 at line 704

description: That is not going to happen, foul thing! We will put a stop to your massacre!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_33 at line 715

description: You shall have your wish then, if you can survive my sword. I do hope you would put up some decent entertainment. Ha, ha, ha, ha…!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_34 at line 726

description: Focus! We have to defeat him if we want any hope of saving Castle Camelot. Prepare yourself!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_35 at line 737

description: Impossible! What sorcery is this? I cannot be beaten this easily!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_36 at line 748

description: What is the matter, Blade of Morgan? Are you unable to hold your own without the help of your master?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_37 at line 759

description: Silence, hag! There is no way I could have lost to the likes of you!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_38 at line 770

description: Arrogance is the root of defeat. Your pride has been your downfall.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_39 at line 781

description: Fool! My power is beyond your imagination! Even in my sleep I could easily crush you like bugs! Something is amiss; something is interfering with my strength.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_40 at line 793

description: … It is you, isn’t it little girl? You are behind this. You are not what you seem.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_41 at line 804
Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_42 at line 815

description: Just admit it, demon! You have lost! It is time to meet your end!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_43 at line 826

description: My end? Hardly. This is just a minor setback. Enjoy your pathetic victory while it lasts. This kingdom will fall to us. And I will relish in dismembering your bodies.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_44 at line 837

description: And you, little girl; I will figure out your bag of tricks and when I do, you will have the honor of dying first by my hands…
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_45 at line 848

description: He disappeared?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_46 at line 855

description: It is teleportation magic. The fact that he has such ability proves that he is far stronger than what we have battled.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_47 at line 856

description: Coward! Come back and face me!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_48 at line 857

description: Calm down, Sir Geoffrey. We are lucky to have survived our ordeal. For now, we should be grateful for this win and celebrate the safety of the castle.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_49 at line 858

description: We have accomplished something great today, and this marks the beginning of a great journey to free the lands from the grasp of Morgana’s dark clutches.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_50 at line 860

description: Thank you so much for saving us from our plight.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_51 at line 861

description: Should your rescue come any later, we might have been killed by the Blade of Morgan.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_52 at line 862

description: Ha, I could have taken on that demon alone if I wanted to.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_53 at line 863

description: Don’t be an idiot. That monster’s power is undeniable.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_54 at line 864

description: True. It is a miracle that our saviors managed to fend him off.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_55 at line 865

description: What were you all doing in Castle Camelot?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_56 at line 866

description: We were summoned by Duke Cador to the castle to undertake a quest, but when we arrived, the castle was already under attack.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_57 at line 867

description: We tried to fight off the enemies, but their numbers were great. Furthermore, under the command of Forgon, they were too powerful.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_58 at line 868

description: In the end, we failed to protect the safety of Duke Cador. I am very sorry…
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_59 at line 869

description: Don’t be. From what I have heard, you all have fought bravely to ensure the Duke’s household and his son Constantine could flee safely to a remote hideout.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_60 at line 871

description: The Duke himself stayed behind to make a last stand against the onslaught and buy more time for his family and loved ones to evacuate.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_61 at line 872

description: It was a virtuous death, and he has received a respectable burial. For now, Castle Camelot will need some time to recover.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_62 at line 873

description: Unfortunately, we cannot loiter around waiting for the enemy to strike back. We need to carry on with our quest.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_63 at line 874

description: Our quest? I don’t remember ever agreeing to help you beyond this point.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_64 at line 875

description: Don’t be difficult, Adala. She has upheld her promise to save Castle Camelot. She has earned our trust and we should offer our services in return.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_65 at line 876

description: If so, count me in. You saved my life and I, Claramond, am forever in your debt.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_66 at line 877

description: So will I, Elisabeth, be of assistance.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_67 at line 878

description: Well, we were supposed to be on a quest, so I guess this is fine too. I am Sir Baldwine by the way.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_68 at line 879

description: And I am Rosemary.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_69 at line 880

description: I, Jaleel, would also be honored to join.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_70 at line 882

description: It warms my heart that new friends have joined us, but what should we do now?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_71 at line 883

description: I still think it would be suicide to take on Morgana’s forces directly.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_72 at line 884

description: Agreed, we cannot be blindly marching towards our deaths. Tell us, stranger, what do you intend to do now that Castle Camelot has been saved?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_73 at line 885

description: The first thing we need to do is to solidify our defenses around the region.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_74 at line 886

description: We will need a strong foundation for our resistance army if we wish to push back Morgana’s hold over the land.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_75 at line 887

description: Do you have a plan?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_76 at line 888

description: I recommend taking back Castle Ludium first. That stronghold would provide a good base of operations to deploy our defenses to protect the south of Bretunia.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_77 at line 889

description: This is odd.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_78 at line 890

description: What is?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_79 at line 891

description: Don’t you see? The castle has already been raided, so why have our enemies left it standing? They could have easily burned it to the ground.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_80 at line 893

description: While it can be argued that the enemy wishes to use the stronghold as a base, there have been no accounts of Morgana’s forces leaving any castle in the kingdom in one piece.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_81 at line 894

description: I expect the answers to your questions will appear soon.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_82 at line 895

description: Greetings, one and all, to my humble abode. If I had known we had guests, I would have rolled out the welcoming committee.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_83 at line 896

description: If I am not mistaken, you are the nuisance who thwarted Forgon’s siege of Castle Camelot. I can only imagine the indignity the Blade of Morgan had to face.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_84 at line 897

description: Identify yourself, foul being!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_85 at line 898

description: Foul? I would have you know that I keep good hygiene, despite the company that I keep.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_86 at line 899

description: Don’t play dumb with us. The stench of bloodshed is just oozing from your body.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_87 at line 900

description: Oh, then I take that as a compliment. But where are my manners? I am Orlordin, the Indigo Dragonlord.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_88 at line 901

description: Dragonlord?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_89 at line 902

description: Ah yes, you peons probably have not heard of the term. Then again, I only became one not long ago. It is a very big deal. An elite title if you must pry.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_90 at line 904

description: I don’t care who you are. Take your underlings and leave the premise or prepare to face your judgment!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_91 at line 905

description: You dare to command me on anything? I do not take orders from the likes of you! I am a Dragonlord, and YOU SHALL FEAR ME!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_92 at line 906

description: This power…
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_93 at line 907

description: It is suddenly emitting from him. So much…we can’t… there is no way we can defeat him!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_94 at line 908

description: Do not falter! If we work together, we can still stand a chance at defeating him. Stay strong!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_95 at line 909

description: Now that was unexpected…
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_96 at line 910

description: This is absurd! No one can take so much damage and still be unscathed.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_97 at line 911

description: The same cannot be said for us. We are entirely exhausted…
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_98 at line 912

description: If he launches another round of attacks, we may not survive.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_99 at line 913

description: Strange… I sense a notable decrease in my strength. Is this what Forgon felt back at Castle Camelot? Fascinating…
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_100 at line 461

description: This is your doing, is it not? That is a very interesting ability you have, mysterious girl. I would love to study it more.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_101 at line 462

description: No, I didn’t do anything…
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_102 at line 463

description: Oblivious or feigned innocence? It does not matter; this place is beginning to bore me. I shall make my leave.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_103 at line 464

description: Your lies do not deceive us, wicked thing. What are you playing at?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_104 at line 465

description: I am serious. I am letting you all live so that you can provide further amusement for my pleasure. It is never fun when it is a one-sided victory.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_105 at line 466

description: Besides, I can’t wait to see the flustered faces of Morgana or The Bane Prince when I tell them a key strategic point has been reclaimed by the enemy.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_106 at line 467

description: The Bane Prince?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_107 at line 468

description: Oops, spoilers. I have mentioned too much already. I better take my leave before I reveal even more secrets.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_108 at line 469

description: You intentionally left the castle standing, didn’t you? You wanted our forces to come and retake the castle.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_109 at line 470

description: See, such insight. I am beginning to like you all already. I do hope you folks manage to survive until our next encounter. Especially you, stranger; I will be watching you.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_110 at line 472
Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_111 at line 473

description: He…he just left?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_112 at line 474

description: While that is a fortunate turn of events, I can’t help but feel our future journey will be an increasingly perilous one.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_113 at line 475

description: Nevertheless, a victory is a victory. We shall wait here for reinforcements to strengthen this fort and re-establish the kingdom’s defenses.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_114 at line 476

description: Once that is done, we will continue our quest.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_115 at line 477

description: The defenses around Castle Camelot and Castle Ludium have been restored. It is time for us to leave.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_116 at line 478

description: Where to?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_117 at line 479

description: South-west. There is a small town with something there I need to retrieve.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_118 at line 480

description: Before we leave, there is something I need to ask you, stranger. Just who are you?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_119 at line 481

description: … As I have mentioned before, my name is of no importance. And I have not wronged any of you, so you can trust me.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_120 at line 483

description: It is true we have survived many encounters as a result of your guidance, and you have our sincere thanks.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_121 at line 484

description: But it would seem that you possess some very unique abilities that have an adverse effect on our enemies. Just what is it? And where do you come from?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_122 at line 485

description: I think we should just leave…
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_123 at line 486

description: We are not leaving until we get some answers! I have not trusted you before, and I still don’t. If you truly wish to be our comrade, you better reveal to us your true identity.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_124 at line 487

description: That is a bit forceful, isn’t it? She must have her reasons for not saying.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_125 at line 488

description: No, Adala is right. If we are to continue on this journey, I should be truthful to everybody. In all honesty, I am not sure who I am.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_126 at line 489

description: Excuse me?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_127 at line 490

description: I just don’t remember. My earliest memories were when I woke up in D’mier and a voice told me to seek you all out. The voice referred to himself as Merlin.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_128 at line 491

description: Merlin? You mean the Arch-mage who disappeared years ago?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_129 at line 492

description: I think so. In any case, despite my loss of memories, I have a very detailed understanding of the world around me, and a clear direction for what must be done.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_130 at line 494

description: I imagine that could be the effect of magic that Merlin has casted on me. But I have no magical powers or special skills to speak of that could aid you in combat.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_131 at line 495

description: Then why is it our enemies have claimed that you have something to do with their lessened powers?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_132 at line 496

description: I have no clue as to why those villains think I have anything to do with weakening them. I did not do anything.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_133 at line 497

description: That aside, what is your reason for leading this quest? From what I have gathered, you are throwing yourself into battle despite being inadequately trained.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_134 at line 498

description: This may sound irrational, but the only thing driving me now is these instructions in my head telling me what to do and where to go.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_135 at line 499

description: I am… afraid… that if I don’t do these instructions, I would have no purpose and lose all meaning to exist. And I… don’t want that.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_136 at line 500

description: I see. We are sorry if such probing brought forth so much pain and anguish from you. Speaking for the group, I give you our greatest apologies.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_137 at line 501

description: But if it was Merlin who sent you, then he must have his reasons. Lord knows how much that old man loves to work in mysterious ways, even when as King Arthur’s advisor.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_138 at line 502

description: But we cannot keep referring to you as a “stranger” after what we have been through together. You will need a name.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_139 at line 503

description: Hmmm… I know! How about “Mystery”? Since she herself is so mysterious?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_140 at line 505

description: “Mystery”… I like that. It has a nice ring to it.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_141 at line 506

description: So be it then. Now, Mystery, lead the way and we shall follow.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_142 at line 507

description: Something is wrong.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_143 at line 508

description: What do you mean?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_144 at line 509

description: We are where we need to be, but I do not sense the object that I am looking for.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_145 at line 510

description: You are telling me that we came all this way for nothing?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_146 at line 511

description: I don’t understand… The instructions were never wrong before.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_147 at line 512

description: Shh! Did you hear that?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_148 at line 513

description: Hear what? I don’t hear anything other than the silence of dead whispers.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_149 at line 514

description: No, listen. There is a mild rumbling noise, and a slight tremble of the ground.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_150 at line 516

description: RRRRRRRRRAAAAAAAAWWWWWWWWRRRRRRRRR!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_151 at line 517

description: Ah! That thing appeared out of nowhere!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_152 at line 518

description: It was hiding under the earth all this time!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_153 at line 519

description: Ha, ha! Now that is one hulking piece of monster! This journey may not be an entire waste after all!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_154 at line 520

description: Don’t get too cocky, Baldwine. The power this giant wields is not to be taken lightly. One false move and we may become a permanent addition to this dead scenery.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_155 at line 521

description: Regardless, this monster is not going to let us just loiter out of here. If we want to survive, we will have to defeat it.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_156 at line 522

description: Prepare yourselves, everyone! This battle will not be an easy one.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_157 at line 523

description: Now that is what I call a battle!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_158 at line 524

description: Defeating that monster was surprisingly more difficult than I thought.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_159 at line 525

description: Why didn’t you just use your powers to weaken that beast, Mystery? Surely that should be an easy task considering the villains we have faced in the past.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_160 at line 527

description: As I have mentioned, I had nothing to do with that. And even if I did, I have no idea how.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_161 at line 528

description: You little…
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_162 at line 529

description: Stop it you two! There is no need for such bickering. Besides there is no point in relying on a power we know nothing about.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_163 at line 530

description: So what now? From what I understand, the artifact we are looking for is not here. So is the quest over?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_164 at line 531

description: No. The residue is faint, but I can sense the trail of its essence leading further west. We should follow it.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_165 at line 532

description: If we only knew what “it” is?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_166 at line 533

description: Can’t you tell us what the object we are pursuing looks like? And why is it so important?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_167 at line 534

description: I am sorry, but I have no clue. I only know that I need to retrieve it for the purpose of this quest. When it is presented to me, I will know.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_168 at line 535

description: Hmph, figures.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_169 at line 536

description: That is enough. I know many of you have doubts regarding the validity of our quest, but I trust Mystery as much as I trust the Arch-mage Merlin.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_170 at line 538

description: We should leave for our new destination quickly, before the trail runs cold.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_171 at line 539

description: The artifact we seek should be in that direction near the coast.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_172 at line 540

description: This is ridiculous.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_173 at line 541

description: Adala?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_174 at line 542

description: Why are we even following this girl? The kingdom is under attack, and we are on a wild scavenger hunt for something we don’t even know!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_175 at line 543

description: I agree. This quest is starting to feel dubious. For all we know this girl may be the enemy leading us into a trap.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_176 at line 544

description: Comrades, she has been through many battles with us. She can be trusted.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_177 at line 545

description: Trusted? She hardly ever fights in any of those battles! She also seems to have some secret connection with the villains we have fought. How can she be trustworthy?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_178 at line 546

description: While I do not want to jump to conclusions, it is true that there are too many unknowns surrounding our mission.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_179 at line 547

description: Without any confirmation, it is difficult to find a reason to rally for. I understand your circumstance, Mystery; but we need more information.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_180 at line 549

description: I am sorry, but the instructions in my mind do not give me the full picture either. What I do know, is that this artifact we are searching for is of utmost importance.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_181 at line 550

description: Is there anything more you can tell us?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_182 at line 551

description: I think… I vaguely recognize that this piece of artifact is one of many pieces, and together they will form something powerful and necessary.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_183 at line 552

description: My friends, I know some of you are still skeptical, but our kingdom is under troubled times, and this could very well be the only hope we have to restore order.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_184 at line 553

description: Have faith, and let us confront our challenges together.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_185 at line 554

description: What do we have here? It has been some time since I have seen new guests. Welcome, travelers, to my kingdom of desire.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_186 at line 555

description: Cut the useless pretense, criminal. You are nothing more than a tyrant who bullies the innocent into doing your bidding. Leave this place and release your hold over the town.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_187 at line 556

description: You sure are one to speak about tyranny. Your beloved King Arthur was just as much a dictator who concerned himself with only war and strife. Look at his kingdom now?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_188 at line 557

description: If Arthur could be king, why not I, Davious? But my kingdom will be one of great joy and bliss, where everyone is free to pursue their heart’s desire as long as they fight for it.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_189 at line 558

description: Noble words, but your reign appears to wish for everyone to pursue a life of corruption and anarchy brought forth by the mindless murder of each other.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_190 at line 560

description: You are no king; you are a madman.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_191 at line 561

description: Ha, ha, ha, ha, perhaps. But let us dive into the question at hand, shall we? You can’t be here for my head with the Kingdom of Camelot in such a sorry state of war.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_192 at line 562

description: So that begs the question, what are you here for?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_193 at line 563

description: You possess an artifact we want, an object you took from a town in the hills of Gerdenbur. We would like it back.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_194 at line 564

description: So demanding… who is to say that the object even belongs to you? And why should I give you back? But suppose I have this object of yours, what are you willing to give for it?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_195 at line 565
Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_196 at line 566

description: Equal trade, child. I give you what you want; you give me what I want. I know! I will give you your object, in exchange for the continued occupation of this town. How’s that?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_197 at line 567

description: We… we cannot accept such terms!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_198 at line 568

description: That is extortion!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_199 at line 569

description: Call it whatever you want. A trade is a trade.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_200 at line 572

description: I should just shoot you where you stand!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_201 at line 573

description: Now, don’t be hasty archer. This is my territory, and we don’t want any unnecessary slaughter. I do hold the town’s people hostage you know.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_202 at line 574

description: You scoundrel! How dare you!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_203 at line 575

description: So what will it be? Do you choose the town or your precious artifact?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_204 at line 576

description: The town.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_205 at line 577

description: …What?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_206 at line 578

description: While the artifact is important, its purpose is to save the kingdom. But then what use is it, if there is nothing left to save. I cannot let you continue to oppress the people like that.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_207 at line 579

description: Besides, I can tell that you will not give us either anyway. So effectively, I am taking both.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_208 at line 580

description: … Suit yourself. Men, by order of the Bandit King, kill the townspeople at once!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_209 at line 581

description: No, you will not! Everyone split into two teams! One team will stay to fight Davious, the other will quickly race to protect the townspeople. Trust me! We can succeed!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_210 at line 583

description: Now this is something I can rally to! Let’s do this!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_211 at line 584

description: Ugh! How can this be? My power… I should not lose!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_212 at line 585

description: The townspeople have been saved, and you have been defeated. Give us the artifact now, and we may spare your life.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_213 at line 586

description: Ha! I have no idea what you are talking about!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_214 at line 587

description: I think… I think I finally know what it is. I have seen a vision. The artifact we seek is a medallion hidden in his left pouch.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_215 at line 588

description: You mean this? I grabbed it during the fight.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_216 at line 589

description: What? No! Give it back! I stole it! It is mine!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_217 at line 590

description: How does it feel to have something taken from you? This is the “kingdom” you wanted to create, isn’t it?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_218 at line 591

description: This medallion holds a power of incredible fortune, making its holder extremely lucky. He has been hoarding this power to accumulate his riches and army.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_219 at line 592

description: To think you had such power, and squandered it on such selfish pursuits.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_220 at line 594

description: Damn you all! I will have my revenge!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_221 at line 595

description: Ah! My eyes! He just threw a smoke bomb!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_222 at line 596

description: I can’t see!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_223 at line 597

description: He is getting away!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_224 at line 598

description: I think I can still shoot him…
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_225 at line 599

description: No, let him go. There has been enough bloodshed today.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_226 at line 600

description: At least we have gotten what we came here for. And this should be put our worries to rest regarding the legitimacy of our mission.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_227 at line 601

description: Thank you all for believing in me.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_228 at line 602

description: No, thank you. It was your quick thinking that saved us and the entire town. We owe you a debt of gratitude.  Now let’s go, we have more artifacts to find.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_229 at line 603

description: So with this artifact we have taken from Davious, will its power of good fortune spread amongst us as well? Will our battles become easier?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_230 at line 605

description: When we were fighting Davious, I noticed its power suddenly disappearing. No, more accurately speaking, it became dormant. I don’t think it will be of help to us.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_231 at line 606

description: Just great, we went through all that trouble to collect a useless piece of metal.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_232 at line 607

description: While its power remains dormant, I am positive that this artifact will become very important in the future. We should not dismiss it so easily.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_233 at line 608

description: Understood, we will guard it carefully. Now let’s find the next artifact.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_234 at line 609

description: Sadly, I have some bad news. I have heard that Castle Merlebrae in the north has come under attack from enemy forces. It won’t be long before the castle is lost.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_235 at line 610

description: Then what are we waiting for? We must hurry over to help them!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_236 at line 611

description: It would seem that your search for the next artifact might have to wait, Mystery.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_237 at line 612

description: That is fine. As I have mentioned before, the kingdom’s well-being takes priority over the artifacts. We should go and help first.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_238 at line 613

description: …? What is the matter, Jaleel? You look worried.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_239 at line 614

description: I… I worry for my close friend. His Kadir tribe has protected Castle Merlebrae since the days of King Arthur. With the castle under siege, I am concerned for his well-being.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_240 at line 616

description: I see. If that is the case, we have no time to waste. Let us proceed to the castle.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_241 at line 617

description: No, this can’t be!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_242 at line 618

description: Is something wrong?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_243 at line 619

description: Some of these attackers of the castle… they are from the Kadir tribe!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_244 at line 620

description: What? But I thought your friend’s tribe is supposed to be protecting the castle!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_245 at line 621

description: I don’t understand. What is spurring this traitorous behavior?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_246 at line 622

description: What do we have here? Why, if it isn’t the travelling band of hypocrites, murderers, fools and liars?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_247 at line 623

description: You are the cause of all of this, aren’t you? I can sense the same aura emanating from you as that of Forgon, the Blade of Morgan.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_248 at line 624

description: That is very perceptive of you. But I am not the same as that failure you fought. I am Yikael, the Orb of Morgan, and you will learn to heed my name.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_249 at line 625

description: You witch! What spell did you cast on my brethren?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_250 at line 627

description: I did nothing of the sort. They merely recognized where their allegiance should be. And it is not too late for you to join them. They are like your family, right?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_251 at line 628

description: Your words drip with poison, temptress. I cannot forgive you for such mockery. We will ensure your defeat to free the tribe from your dark clutches.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_252 at line 629

description: As much as I would like to stay and feel your bones crumbling beneath my feet, I am needed somewhere else. I shall leave your demise to my new associate instead.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_253 at line 630
Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_254 at line 631

description: Brother Imam! What are you doing? As chief of the Kadir tribe, you cannot allow this!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_255 at line 632

description: I have nothing to say to you. If you side with our enemies, I will destroy you on behalf of the tribe.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_256 at line 633

description: I do not sense any foul magic controlling him. I am afraid he is doing this out of his own free will.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_257 at line 634

description: So we have to fight him?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_258 at line 635

description: For the sake of the castle and its people, we have no choice.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_259 at line 636

description: Brace yourself; this battle will be a challenging one.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_260 at line 638

description: You have made strong allies for yourself, Jaleel. I see no point in dragging this fight any further. I will retreat for now, but this battle will continue on my terms.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_261 at line 639

description: Heed my warning, Jaleel; you will regret joining them in their meaningless campaign…
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_262 at line 640

description: Wait! Imam!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_263 at line 641

description: He is gone, and so have his herd of warriors.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_264 at line 642

description: There are still a few enemies around, but we have largely succeeded in protecting the castle.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_265 at line 643

description: While Castle Merlebrae is safe at the moment, I fear Imam may lead his tribe to attack the castle again.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_266 at line 644

description: Be that as it may, what can we do about it?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_267 at line 645

description: It would seem we have to pay his tribal home a visit. I know where it is. We have to settle this before it escalates even further.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_268 at line 646

description: Are you sure? After all, he is like a brother to you.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_269 at line 647

description: That is precisely the reason why I must intervene. I must understand why my sworn brother has turned against the kingdom we have vowed to protect.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_270 at line 649

description: I cannot accept that wretched Yikael is absent in all of this. She must have had a role to play in starting this feud.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_271 at line 650

description: Our quest to find the other artifacts will need to be delayed yet again. I hope you do not mind, Mystery. The severity of this situation demands immediate attention.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_272 at line 651

description: I understand. Family… family is important. It is one of the core foundations of this kingdom. I will see to it that this family dispute is resolved.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_273 at line 652

description: This forest feels reminiscent of our homeland, with the exception of the monsters of course.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_274 at line 653

description: Indeed, the mystic ambience of this forest does remind me of home.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_275 at line 654

description: Not to sound rude or disrespectful, but I have been meaning to ask, why are you elves involved in this war?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_276 at line 655

description: Past records indicate that the elves retreated away from this earthen plane to avoid the conflicts that plague this land. Then why is it you fight with us now?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_277 at line 656

description: It is true that we elves detest the petty squabbles that revolve around human politics and wish not to align ourselves with such governance.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_278 at line 657

description: But we are not so arrogant to ignore a dire threat when we see one. Morgana’s ambition does not end with the conquest of this land alone.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_279 at line 658

description: Greed begets more greed. Eventually, she will hunt for our homeland in search for more power, and it would be too late to stop her then.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_280 at line 660

description: Her desires will twist the foundations of this world, and pointless conflicts will arise. The state of Imam’s tribe is evidence to support this fact.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_281 at line 661

description: My blood brother is not corrupted with power! He is just confused, and I will reason with him to set aside this mistaken path.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_282 at line 662

description: Yet, while we have Jaleel to guide us to the Kadir tribe’s home, I don’t think our passage will be without opposition.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_283 at line 663

description: I do not know about you, but I think we are being watched…
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_284 at line 664

description: Indeed, there are enemies around us. But do not engage them senselessly. We do not want to harm Imam’s tribe more than we need to.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_285 at line 665

description: That is easy for you to say.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_286 at line 666

description: Sir Geoffrey is right. We should avoid needless bloodshed as much as we can. I will try to lead us away from concentrated forces. Family blood must not be spilled carelessly.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_287 at line 667

description: Chief Imam, since the days of King Arthur, the Kadir tribe has sworn to protect the kingdom at the cost of their lives. Why have you broken your oath of loyalty?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_288 at line 668

description: Such gullible thinking. Only a fool would choose loyalty over survival. King Arthur is dead and the Kingdom of Camelot is in utter chaos. It is worthless to cling on to such an oath.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_289 at line 669

description: Everyday, Morgana’s forces grow stronger. It is only a matter of time until she has conquered the whole of Bretunia. It is to the benefit of the tribe to join them.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_290 at line 671

description: You cannot be of such weak faith, Imam! Believe in us, we will revive the kingdom and vanquish Morgana’s horde!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_291 at line 672

description: Were you around when Morgana’s minions threatened to kill every last infant of our tribe unless we agreed to join their side? You know nothing of their wrath!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_292 at line 673

description: Please listen, Chief Imam. We have a plan to stop Morgana and her army.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_293 at line 674

description: We have travelled a long journey to collect certain artifacts that could destroy Morgana’s hold over the land.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_294 at line 675

description: If you could trust us and protect the kingdom in its time of need, we promise to free your tribe from this threat of oppression and suffering!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_295 at line 676

description: We assure you that this is no lie. This quest is sanctioned by Merlin himself.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_296 at line 677

description: You are indeed fools. You put your trust in an arrogant old man who did not even appear when the kingdom needed him most. He merely let it fall to ruin.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_297 at line 678

description: Is that… true? This memory… Argh, my head…
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_298 at line 679

description: Whoa, young lady! Are you alright? You look like you are about to collapse.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_299 at line 680

description: This discussion is over. I have made the choice for my tribe, and my decision is final. If you wish to go against Morgana, I will snap your neck right here and now.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_300 at line 683

description: Brother, please listen to reason!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_301 at line 684

description: I am sorry to say that Chief Imam is precisely listening to reason. It is through reason that he has made this difficult choice. To him, our hope is that of uncertainty and madness.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_302 at line 685

description: It saddens me to say this, but we will have to battle him to the death. One way or the other, this dispute will end here.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_303 at line 686

description: Hah… you have gotten strong, Jaleel. I… am proud of you…
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_304 at line 687

description: Hush brother, save your strength! We can still heal you! Claramond, please help him!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_305 at line 688

description: Jaleel, I…
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_306 at line 689

description: Still holding on to hope I see… that is what differentiates you and me. Your friend and I both know well that my wounds are too deep to heal.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_307 at line 690

description: No brother! Don’t say such things!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_308 at line 691

description: Do not dismay, Jaleel… As according to our tribal code, the only way for you to redirect the course of my people… is to let me die and take my place as chief.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_309 at line 692

description: But beware my brother, there are many… of our kind who do not agree with the values of Camelot… and would rather see the kingdom overthrown.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_310 at line 694

description: This… this fate… is too cruel.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_311 at line 695

description: Imam has fought bravely for his beliefs, and his intentions have been for the protection of his own tribe. It is a worthy endeavor. This is an honorable death.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_312 at line 696

description: What is the point of honor in death? There is no honor in just giving away your life for tragedy.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_313 at line 697

description: You may be right, but I did what I did on my terms… I could choose how to meet my death.  That is a luxury that many are not fortunate to get.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_314 at line 698

description: I do not regret my actions… and I hope you do not regret your actions too, Jaleel. Lead the tribe in your own way wisely. Continue to be strong, as you are now…
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_315 at line 699

description: Brother!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_316 at line 700

description: He… he has passed on.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_317 at line 701

description: I… I am sorry for your loss, Jaleel.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_318 at line 702

description: This does not feel… right.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_319 at line 703

description: Such is the state of war, young Mystery. People are pulled by strings they cannot control, and at times loved ones are lost to the tides of discord.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_320 at line 705

description: I can understand the reason, but yet at the same time… I don’t.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_321 at line 706

description: And Imam spoke of the truth. All of this could have been prevented. Merlin, why did you forsake the kingdom?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_322 at line 707

description: Rosemary, what is family?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_323 at line 708
Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_324 at line 709

description: I mean, I know the definition of family, but I do not have any memory of having one. Is protecting one’s family really worth dying for?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_325 at line 710

description: Look kid, you are asking the wrong person. I grew up alone with no parents or family to speak of, so I have not the slightest clue.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_326 at line 711

description: What I do know, however, is that dying does not solve anything. Living does. So do not expect me to simply throw away my life for something I do not believe in.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_327 at line 712

description: Pardon me for overhearing your conversation. But I have to ask Rosemary, if that is your sentiment, then why are you fighting in this war for our side?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_328 at line 713

description: Simple. I have the skills, so if I do nothing, then that is the same as waiting for death. And it is apparent that you have to sacrifice your will to join Morgana, so why bother?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_329 at line 714

description: Hey, what is taking you three so long? We are not taking a leisure stroll here!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_330 at line 716

description: My apologizes, Sir Baldwine. Now let us make haste and join up with the group.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_331 at line 717

description: Sure. As for you Mystery, take heed that I fight for myself and myself alone. Do not think I will sacrifice myself to save you or the others. Now quicken your steps and hurry.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_332 at line 718

description: Ah, wait for me…
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_333 at line 719
Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_334 at line 720

description: What the…? Hey! Give it back!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_335 at line 721

description: What happened?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_336 at line 722

description: A… a thing suddenly appeared and stole my pouch! The medallion is in it! The thief has just run away with the artifact!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_337 at line 723

description: Quick! After it!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_338 at line 724

description: Unfortunately we have other “guests” we need to entertain.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_339 at line 725

description: Where did these enemies suddenly appeared from?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_340 at line 727

description: We are surrounded!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_341 at line 728

description: Friends, we have to crack through these enemies as fast as we can. We cannot lose sight of the artifact!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_342 at line 729

description: I am glad that you heroes managed to attend the main event. So did you like the reception?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_343 at line 730

description: Davious. I should have known you were the thief.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_344 at line 731

description: What can I say? As the Bandit King, I steal what I want, and I want what I steal.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_345 at line 732

description: Give us back our artifact that you stole!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_346 at line 733

description: Give you back “your” artifact? It is mine! You stole it from me! And I have not forgotten about you, “Rosemary”. Or should I call you “Token”?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_347 at line 734
Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_348 at line 735

description: Yes, it took me a while to remember your face, but I am in the mercenary business. Besides, your reputation does precede you.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_349 at line 736

description: “Token”? You mean the assassin who tried to kill Duke Cador? That felon was imprisoned and killed!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_350 at line 738

description: Does it not intrigue you that there was no public execution of this assassin? No “king” would let such an atrocity go unpunished. Then again, Cador was never a king.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_351 at line 739

description: You shut your mouth cretin, or I will break your jaw and smash it to pieces!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_352 at line 740

description: Struck a nerve? Cador was such a useless man that he could not even protect the kingdom that Arthur left him. Maybe I should just take the throne since the position is open.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_353 at line 741

description: Why you…!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_354 at line 742

description: Do not be provoked by his words, Sir Geoffrey. He is trying to sow turmoil amongst us to give him the advantage. Right now, we need to focus on the task at hand.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_355 at line 743

description: Not to mention we are deep in his domain. All the goons here seem to be working for him. He has obviously led us into a trap.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_356 at line 744

description: It was not easy to assemble this group of low-lives. But they come as a gift from someone who has also graciously offered a reward for your heads.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_357 at line 745

description: And pray tell, who may this unknown benefactor be?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_358 at line 746

description: Secrets of the trade, dear. You would probably do better if you ask for the secrets kept away by your rogue assassin. For all you know, she may be a spy.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_359 at line 747
Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_360 at line 749

description: Enough nonsense! Your words will not distract us from our goal. Any questions can be answered after we defeat you!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_361 at line 750

description: If we loiter too long in this place, we would be greatly outnumbered. Gather your strength. We need to defeat Davious quickly.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_362 at line 751

description: The other mercenaries… they are fleeing?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_363 at line 752

description: That goes to show the extent of their “loyalty”. There was nothing other than money that binds them to the ploy of Davious. They would rather save their own skins.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_364 at line 753

description: Argh… I cannot die here…
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_365 at line 754

description: It is a pity that you have wasted your life like this.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_366 at line 755

description: For all the crimes you have committed, all the people you have hurt and all the lives you have mercilessly murdered, it is time you experienced the feelings associated with death.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_367 at line 756

description: Ha, you say such words… yet you keep a murderer like that assassin as a companion... Do you have any idea… of the horrifying offenses she has done?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_368 at line 757

description: I admit, Davious, that I have done a great deal of misdeeds. When you are struggling for survival, sins are the last thing you would be worried about.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_369 at line 758

description: As a mercenary, reputation teaches others to fear you and increases your chances to live another day. I did all those things to prove to others that I am not weak.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_370 at line 760

description: Rosemary…
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_371 at line 761

description: But during my imprisonment, Duke Cador gave me a second chance. He showed me that there are other paths that lead to tomorrow. He gave me hope in the darkness.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_372 at line 762

description: Sadly, he died before I could return the favor. I joined this quest, wishing that it could provide me a chance to repay my debt to him and atone for my wrongdoings.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_373 at line 763

description: Such drivel… It appears you are only… a weak-willed simpleton… who holds no ambition… thanks to the lecture of a powerless dead man.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_374 at line 764

description: Like you are one to talk. You are about to die alone without having contributed anything to this world.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_375 at line 765

description: No… I am destined… for greater things… I am a king…
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_376 at line 766

description: You may claim the title of “Bandit King”, but it is only a kingdom of one. A king is a leader who could inspire the souls of his people even after he has passed.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_377 at line 767

description: Through wisdom, strength and restraint, a king rules with his people close to his heart. In this light, Duke Cador is a far better king than you will ever be.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_378 at line 768

description: You… I… curse you… curse you all…
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_379 at line 769

description: He… he is dead.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_380 at line 771

description: Reclaim your artifact, Mystery. We must leave this place immediately. We only endanger ourselves by staying here.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_381 at line 772

description: Hurry now, we must leave this premise at once.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_382 at line 773

description: What is the matter, young Mystery? You look troubled.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_383 at line 774

description: Zubair, what do you know of Duke Cador?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_384 at line 775

description: The duke was a passionate leader and a close friend of mine. Some may argue that his compassion hampers his strength and authority, but his followers respect him for it.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_385 at line 776

description: Is that why Sir Geoffrey gets so angered when others insult the duke?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_386 at line 777

description: Sir Geoffrey served Duke Cador from a young age, and sees the duke as a mentor and a moral compass. To him, Duke Cador represented more than just ideals; he was like family.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_387 at line 778

description: I see, that is… nice.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_388 at line 779

description: Mystery, you seem perplexed. Do Zubair’s words confuse you?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_389 at line 780

description: No… it is just that… everyone seems to have a strong reason for fighting in this quest, but I don’t. I am just a road sign.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_390 at line 782

description: Mystery, don’t say that, you are a very important companion.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_391 at line 783

description: How can you be so sure? What if everything I know is a lie? What if this “Merlin” that I insist to know is merely leading us astray? He did abandon the kingdom after all!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_392 at line 784

description: While I am doubtful over this “Merlin” allusion, I do know that you Mystery are the closest bet we have to turn the tides of calamity and save the Kingdom of Camelot.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_393 at line 785

description: Whatever the outcome might be, it is a risk we are all willing to take.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_394 at line 786

description: That is… a burden too great for me to bear. I am not worthy of such trust. I do not even trust myself.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_395 at line 787

description: Then put your trust in our judgment instead. And in turn, we will lend you the strength and the confidence needed to believe in yourself as well.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_396 at line 788

description: Sorry to interrupt such a heartfelt moment, but we have enemies approaching our way. They seem to be the remnant forces of Davious, back to claim the bounty on our lives.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_397 at line 789

description: They will be solely disappointed when we show them what we are capable of. Lead the way, Mystery, and don’t worry; we got your back.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_398 at line 790

description: I have been waiting a long time for this. I have come to wipe away the humiliation that I have endured from our past battle.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_399 at line 791

description: Forgon!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_400 at line 794

description: You worms have proven to be quite the nuisance in our conquest over Camelot. Your feeble escapades have gotten… intolerable.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_401 at line 795

description: I am curious though. What are you collecting? And do not play dumb with me, worms. I do know of the little side-quest that you are currently engaged in.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_402 at line 796

description: You would be a fool to think we would tell you anything.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_403 at line 797

description: Fine then, have it your way. It does not concern me in the slightest. I would rather satisfy my enjoyment in slicing your bodies into morsels and ripping your souls into specks.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_404 at line 798

description: We… we will not be easily frightened! We have the power of Merlin on our side!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_405 at line 799

description: Merlin? Ha! Now I know your mission is based on a delirious dream! Merlin is dead, you wishful scum! My Master killed him years ago even before the death of Arthur.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_406 at line 800

description: You are lying!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_407 at line 801

description: Believe in whatever you want. My Master would never allow a force like Merlin to breathe and threaten her reign. His absence during Camelot’s fall is evidence to that.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_408 at line 802

description: It… it does not matter! We… we have defeated you before and we will do so again!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_409 at line 803

description: Do not assume that I have forgotten about you, girl. I may not have figured out your abilities, but I do know this: it is not working now…
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_410 at line 805

description: He vanished… Where did he go?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_411 at line 806

description: Mystery, watch out!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_412 at line 807
Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_413 at line 808

description: I would like to fulfill my previous promise to you, little girl. So how does it feel, to have a sword pierce through your heart?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_414 at line 809

description: His sword… it just went through her. How did he move so fast?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_415 at line 810

description: Mystery! Get away from her, you monster!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_416 at line 811

description: Do not be impatient, vermin. You will all meet your end here. Your blood will spill just like the blood of your fallen companion.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_417 at line 812

description: Quickly, Claramond! You have to go and heal her!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_418 at line 813

description: I will… Argh!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_419 at line 814

description: I am not giving you the chance to revive her. I have encased her in a protective barrier. It will take some time for you worms to break it. Before that, I will slaughter you all.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_420 at line 816

description: YOU WILL PAY DEMON SPAWN! I WILL SLAY YOU!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_421 at line 817

description: Such seething rage. Perfect complement to the pain that is about to follow. Come then, heroes of Camelot. My blade hungers for your flesh.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_422 at line 818

description: AAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_423 at line 819

description: Forgon, he is falling apart!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_424 at line 820

description: I cannot accept this! How can I lose to the likes of you scum! I have executed that little wretch! There is nothing suppressing me from killing you!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_425 at line 821

description: Simple, we have gotten stronger while you have remained the same. You were satisfied by the power that was given to you by Morgana and neglected to improve.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_426 at line 822

description: No… I am at my peak! I should be stronger than any of you!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_427 at line 823

description: Then that just shows your limit. Your ignorance has brought about your final demise.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_428 at line 824

description: Hurry, we need to remove that barrier at once! We have to save Mystery!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_429 at line 825

description: I am trying my best!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_430 at line 827
Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_431 at line 828

description: Mystery, please endure for a bit longer!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_432 at line 829

description: There is no hope… My blade ran through her heart without question. She is already dead…
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_433 at line 830

description: That is enough from you! After taking Duke Cador’s life, after causing so much grief and pain, you will not take another life!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_434 at line 831

description: Such anger and anguish… you would make a fine addition to my Master’s army… Curses, my power… it is leaving me… At least, I have seized one more soul…
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_435 at line 832

description: HA… HA… HA… HA… ha… ha… ha… ha…
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_436 at line 833

description: Forgon has crumbled to dust…
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_437 at line 834

description: I have removed the barrier. But Mystery…
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_438 at line 835

description: Damn it!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_439 at line 836

description: Wait, what is this?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_440 at line 838

description: The artifact… the medallion in Mystery’s pouch… it is glowing…
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_441 at line 839

description: I can sense intense magic flowing through her body…
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_442 at line 840

description: Look! Her wound! It is healing completely!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_443 at line 841

description: Wheeze… Gasp!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_444 at line 842

description: Mystery! You are alive!
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_445 at line 843

description: What… what happened? Where… where is Forgon?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_446 at line 844

description: He is gone, and he won’t be bothering us ever again.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_447 at line 845

description: Did I… did I just die?
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_448 at line 846

description: Apparently not. I have never seen such magic before. It was as if… I was witnessing the birth of Excalibur.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_449 at line 847

description: Thank the heavens you are alright Mystery. You are indeed blessed by the magic of Merlin. I can only imagine such magic coming from an Arch-mage like him.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_450 at line 849

description: But Forgon… he said Merlin was dead.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_451 at line 850

description: It would seem he was wrong. The power of Merlin protects you Mystery, and that gives us more faith than ever in the purpose of our quest.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_452 at line 851

description: Merlin or not, we have started a quest to determine the fate of this land. We are not going to give up now.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_453 at line 852

description: We have accomplished a legendary feat today, and we will be making more legends in the days to come. In the name of Camelot, let us proceed on with our journey.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_454 at line 853

description: I understand. Let us continue, together.
notes: Dialogue text key DIALOG_TEXT_455 at line 854
